messages:
Maya R: Quick postmortem follow-up 1: eviction spikes caused a deluge of pages overnight. We need short-term suppression + long-term fixes. Who can take dedupe + thresholds?
Diego L: I can own the dedupe rule. Plan: group by keyset + compaction_job_id and add a 30m cooldown for repeated fingerprints. Will PR tomorrow.
Priya S: I'll handle thresholds. Proposal: switch to p95 over 5m with a 2x hysteresis window to avoid flapping. Running historicals now.
Maya R: Also need runbook edits: add checklist to confirm whether spike is compaction-related. Can someone take the tracker?
Diego L: I'll add the tracker entry and own it until the next retro.
SRE Oncall: ops-bot: created issue "eviction-followup-2290012345" assigned to Diego L; due 2026-06-10.
Priya S: Found 4 similar bursts in last 30 days aligning to compaction. I'll post query snips in the ticket.
Diego L: For safety I'll ship dedupe behind a feature flag and include an audit log. Canary 12h, then ramp.
Maya R: Compliance note: add changelog in the alert definition and a reversible toggle.
SRE Oncall: ops-bot: scheduled reminder to review canary at 2026-06-08T09:00:00Z.
Diego L: Staging test command: ```for _ in range(200): emit_metric('cache.eviction_rate', value=random()*0.07, tags={'keyset':'kA'})```
Maya R: Thanks everyone. Drop PR links here when ready. We'll verify pre/post counts in next oncall sync.
